sections.heading: 浏览器 RPC 使用指南

blocks.text: English · 包概览 · 统一调用规则
应用创建一个 `createRpcHost`，安装一种浏览器传输 plugin，再按需叠加 feature。载体对象由应用取得；plugin 借用它，host 拥有自己的会话、订阅与调用资源。
页面与 Worker 都必须运行同一套 RPC 协议。下面页面代码借用已创建的 Worker；返回业务结果后先关 host，再由创建者终止 Worker。
Worker 模块使用 `dedicatedWorkerPlugin({ worker: self })`，并在同一个 `createRpcHost` 中提供 `provide: { double: (value: number) => value * 2 }`。Worker 端文件应使用 Worker 全局类型，而不是把页面的 Window 类型强制转换成 Worker。
`host.close()` 不调用 `worker.terminate()`。需要复用 Worker 的应用可继续使用该原生对象；应用结束时仍须自行 terminate。此包承载浏览器 Worker；Node、Bun、Deno 原生线程使用 thread plugin。
发送目标与本地接收面分别指定。`origin` 必须非空；除非明确设置 `allowUnsafeTargetOrigin: true`，否则不接纳 `'*'`。除 origin 外还检查真实 `event.source`，因此不能把其他 iframe 的消息当作目标会话。
对端同样把发送目标指向本页面，并提供 `title`。不要把接收消息里的自报身份作为绕过 origin/source 校验的依据。
页面用 `sharedWorkerPlugin({ sharedWorker })`；Worker 端用 `sharedWorkerPlugin({ listen: self })`。这两种来源互斥。Worker listener 从真实 connect 事件接纳每个 MessagePort，每个端口独立握手，同一个 host 仍只拥有一个调用端点。
关闭一条会话不影响其他端口。host 关闭只撤回自己的监听和逻辑会话，不关闭借入端口或 terminate 共享 Worker；原生资源最终归创建者。
向每个参与者传入实际 `BroadcastChannel`，使用 `broadcastChannelPlugin({ channel })`。原发现与 join/leave 握手为每个参与者建立独立来源；频道名不是 peer 身份，原生 broadcast 也不等于已接受的 RPC 目标集合。
调用者负责最后 `await host.close()`，然后再按自身归属关闭 channel。没有当前对端时，无目标调用遵循 host 的空集合行为；对端就绪后，多目标广播返回逐目标结果。默认身份使用唯一实例 ID；显式相同 name 仍执行 host 的同名仲裁。直连调用可使用当前 name 或 peer ID。BroadcastChannel 不提供 transfer list。
页面使用 `serviceWorkerPlugin({ serviceWorker, receiver? })`。`serviceWorker` 是实际发送目标；默认接收面为 `navigator.serviceWorker`，可显式传入容器。Worker 端使用 `serviceWorkerPlugin({ clients: self })`，与页面来源互斥。
Worker 侧根据真实 message 事件的 source.id，通过原生 `clients.get(id)` 解析当前 Client，然后才握手接纳。消息载荷自报的 client ID 不具备来源权限。一个 Client 离开不会关闭其他 Client；本插件不替应用注册、更新或 unregister ServiceWorker。

`rtcDataChannelPlugin({ rtcDataChannel })` 接受已经由应用建立的可靠有序频道：`ordered === true`，`maxRetransmits === null`，`maxPacketLifeTime === null`。不可靠或部分可靠设置在业务前拒绝。应用负责 WebRTC 协商、连接建立及最终 channel.close；host 只拥有其 RPC 订阅。
`webTransportPlugin({ session })` 借用既有 session，等待其 ready，并只创建一次双向可靠流。服务端必须实现兼容的可靠字节 RPC 协议；HTTP 请求处理器或 datagram 服务不能直接充当该对端。
关闭 host 会取消所拥有的 reader、终止 writer 并释放锁，不调用借入 session.close。握手失败、取消和正常关闭都沿同一归属清理。此传输不使用 datagram，也不把流关闭等同于关闭整个 WebTransport session。
所有载体共用 host 的 `request/notify/stream/group/outcome`。双方均可提供业务；多参与者的无目标调用是广播，`send(targetId, method, payload)` 只选当前直连对象。返回的流结束或显式 return 后释放本次调用资源，不 terminate 借入载体。
`connect.timeoutMs` 是 identity/能力握手预算；调用的 `timeoutMs` 与 `signal` 分别约束本次业务。握手前业务不会进入 provider。native structured clone 可用不代表 backing transfer 已资格化；实际会话的能力、认证和 payload 所有权决定显式 transfer 是否允许。
来源与载体错误使用 `rpc.transport.browser`，通用 RPC/握手错误保留 `rpc.endpoint`、`rpc.remote` 等原身份与完整 cause 链。不要仅按 message 匹配，也不要重建错误而丢失原生 TypeError、stack 或 cause。
普通 `PluginHost` 可安装同一传输定义，`name`/`expose` 用于该安装的注册与公开业务。自定义载体使用 host `/plugin` SDK 的原始部署工具；应用直接安装对应 browser plugin。

blocks.text: Common options are `name`, `expose`, and `connect: { timeoutMs }`. SharedWorker and ServiceWorker source alternatives are mutually exclusive. Ordinary objects or client IDs claimed inside payloads do not establish accepted source identity.

Both sides of a session can `provide` and use `request`, `notify`, `stream`, `group`, and `outcome`. With multiple peers, untargeted calls broadcast using the host result rules; `send(nameOrId, method, payload)` selects a current direct peer.

BroadcastChannel participants must finish discovery and handshake; the channel name is not a peer identity. ServiceWorker's `serviceWorker` is the sending target, while `receiver` owns message subscription. Its worker-side source resolves the native Client from the real event source/Client.id before RPC handshake. Window checks both origin and actual event.source. `connect.timeoutMs` bounds preparation; business methods do not run before acceptance.

WebTransport's server must implement the same reliable byte RPC protocol. The plugin owns only its created stream: close releases reader/writer resources and locks without calling the borrowed session's close. Unreliable datagram RPC is not supported.

`await host.close()` withdraws the host's receivers and logical sessions. The application still owns Workers, MessagePorts, BroadcastChannels, RTCDataChannels, and WebTransport sessions it created. Closing a SharedWorker listener does not terminate the shared Worker, and retiring one session does not close others.

Native structured clone does not automatically permit RPC ownership transfer. Transfer depends on actual session capabilities and authentication. BroadcastChannel has no transfer list. Failures retain original causes; clone support does not promise arbitrary lossless JavaScript graph transfer.

Browser source/carrier errors use `rpc.transport.browser`; general handshake/call errors can use `rpc.endpoint` or `rpc.remote`. Inspect source/code/cause. Missing sources, missing Window origins, and unreliable RTC settings reject at their original admission boundary.

The root exports seven plugins, options, and error identity. Plugins reuse module-owned carrier implementations internally; custom raw deployments use the `@migaia/rpc-host/plugin` SDK. See the usage guide.
中文 · Overview · Shared call rules

Create one `createRpcHost`, install one browser transport plugin, and add optional features. Your application supplies the native carrier. The plugin borrows it while the host owns its sessions, subscriptions, and calls.
Both page and Worker must run the compatible RPC protocol. This page helper borrows an existing Worker. Close the host before its creator eventually terminates the Worker.

The Worker module uses `dedicatedWorkerPlugin({ worker: self })` and supplies `provide: { double: (value: number) => value * 2 }` to its own `createRpcHost`. Compile that file with Worker globals rather than casting a page Window into a Worker.

`host.close()` never calls `worker.terminate()`. Applications can reuse their native Worker and remain responsible for its eventual termination. This module owns browser Workers; thread plugin handles native Node, Bun, and Deno threads.

Configure the sending target separately from the local receiver. `origin` must be nonempty. Using `'*'` additionally requires `allowUnsafeTargetOrigin: true`. The carrier also checks the real `event.source`, so another iframe cannot supply this session's messages.
The other side targets this page and provides `title`. A claimed identity in a message never bypasses origin or source checks.

Pages use `sharedWorkerPlugin({ sharedWorker })`. The Worker uses `sharedWorkerPlugin({ listen: self })`. These sources are mutually exclusive. The listener accepts real MessagePorts from native connect events; ports handshake independently while the host retains one call endpoint.

One departing session does not close other ports. Closing the host removes its subscriptions and logical sessions; it neither closes borrowed ports nor terminates the shared Worker. Native resources remain their creator's responsibility.

Pass a real `BroadcastChannel` to `broadcastChannelPlugin({ channel })` on each participant. Existing discovery and join/leave handshakes establish distinct sources. The channel name is not a peer identity, and native broadcast is not the accepted RPC target set.

The caller eventually awaits host.close, then closes the channel according to its own ownership. With no current peers, untargeted calls follow the host's empty-set behavior. With several ready peers, broadcasts return per-target results. Default identity uses a unique instance ID; explicit duplicate names still use host arbitration. Direct calls can use a current name or peer ID. BroadcastChannel has no transfer list.

A page uses `serviceWorkerPlugin({ serviceWorker, receiver? })`. The actual worker is the send target; the default receiving surface is `navigator.serviceWorker`. A Worker uses `serviceWorkerPlugin({ clients: self })`. These sources are mutually exclusive.

The worker resolves native event.source.id with clients.get(id) before accepting that Client's handshake. A client ID claimed inside the payload grants no source authority. One Client leaving does not close the others. This plugin does not register, update, or unregister the ServiceWorker.

`rtcDataChannelPlugin({ rtcDataChannel })` accepts an existing reliable ordered channel: ordered is true and maxRetransmits/maxPacketLifeTime are both null. Unreliable or partially reliable settings fail before business execution. Applications own WebRTC negotiation, connection establishment, and final channel.close; the host owns its RPC subscriptions.

`webTransportPlugin({ session })` borrows an existing session, awaits ready, and creates exactly one reliable bidirectional stream. The server must implement the compatible reliable byte RPC protocol. An ordinary HTTP handler or datagram service is not that counterpart.

Closing the host cancels its reader, aborts its writer, and releases stream locks. It does not call the borrowed session.close. Handshake failure, cancellation, and normal close share that ownership. This transport uses no datagrams and does not equate closing its stream with closing the entire session.

Every carrier uses the same host request/notify/stream/group/outcome operations. Both sides can provide methods. Untargeted multi-peer calls broadcast; send(targetId, method, payload) selects only a current direct peer. Completing or returning an RPC stream releases that call, not the borrowed carrier.

connect.timeoutMs bounds identity and capability negotiation. Per-call timeoutMs and signal bound business work. Business cannot enter a provider before the handshake. Native structured clone alone does not authorize backing transfer: actual session capabilities, authentication, and payload ownership determine eligibility.

Source/carrier errors use rpc.transport.browser. Shared RPC and handshake errors retain rpc.endpoint, rpc.remote, and their original cause graphs. Match source/code rather than message alone, and preserve native error types, stacks, and causes.

An ordinary PluginHost can install the same transport definition; name/expose control its registration and exposed methods. Custom carriers use the host `/plugin` SDK raw deployment tools. Applications install the matching browser plugin.
